operation.summary: Disconnect (or pause) a link at once: calls are refused from now, and it is final after 10 seconds unless undone; any control agent of this device (taking access away needs no owner.configuration grant)

body.name: direction
body.description: in (the other Bridgit uses this one), out (this one uses it) or both (default)

body.name: pause
body.description: true pauses instead (resume with directions {paused:false}, which needs owner.configuration)

operation.returns: the link (id, name, bridgit_name, target, sat_id, role, in{state, services, granter, paused, revoked, other_side}, out{state, agents[{id,name}], granter, paused, revoked, services, other_side}, disconnecting{direction, undo_until}), undo_until

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

pause.description: true pauses instead (resume with directions {paused:false}, which needs owner.configuration)

direction.description: in (the other Bridgit uses this one), out (this one uses it) or both (default)
